text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш was able to stand her
ground against
her elite, senior-year
opponents. It was a heated
competition,
but she's made undeniable progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She'll likely have to race against the two
of them
again at the Arima Kinen, but
Eishin Flash simply
gives a confident nod
and says that just means
she'll have to
win next time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
